sentences.text:
This petition has been filed by the petitioner under Section 397 401 of CrPC against the order dated 23.06.2023 passed in Session trial No. 3/2023 passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Sanawat,
District Mandleshwar, whereby the petitioner who is facing trial under Section 452, 376 506 and 354 of IPC Annexure-P-1 for recalling of the prosecution witness PW-1, the prosecutrix has been rejected.

entities.text:
Additional Sessions Judge, Sanawat,
District Mandleshwar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The case of the petitioner is that he is facing the aforesaid trial in which allegation against him is that he has committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
The prosecutrix has been examined and cross examined before the trial Court as PW-1.

However, subsequently the counsel appearing for the petitioner was changed and after receiving instruction he came to know that the prosecutrix was having an affair with the petitioner and he also had certain photographs and video clips of their relationship.

Photograph of their relationship has been filed which is on record alongwith the present revision and thus an application under Section 311 of CrPC was filed for call of the said Shiva vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10462554/
1 prosecutrix.

entities.text: Shiva vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, the application has been rejected by the trial Judge vide its order dated 23.06.2023 holding that since the cross examination of the prosecutrix has already been over and earlier there was no such request made by the counsel for the petitioner that he wants to take instruction from his client, the petitioner herein and in such circumstances an application was dismissed.

Counsel submitted that if the petitioner is not given the opportunity to cross examine the prosecutrix on the aforesaid ground great prejudice would be caused to defend his case and he shall be deprived of fair trial.
Learned counsel for the respondent on the other hand submitted that no case for interference is made out in the matter.

After considering the aforesaid arguments and on perusal of the record specially photographs on record regarding the relationship of petitioner and the respondent, this Court is of the considered opinion that the petitioner deserves a right to fair trial and to deprive him from producing the aforesaid record will amounts to miscarriage of justice.
In such circumstances, this Court is of the considered opinion that the aforesaid application ought to have been allowed by the trial Court.
Dismissal was not at all warranted.

In such circumstances, the impugned order is hereby set aside and the application filed by the petitioner under Section 311 of Cr.PC is allowed and the trial Court is directed to call the prosecutrix at the expenses of the petitioner and she may be allowed to be further cross examine by the counsel for the petitioner.
With the aforesaid, the present revision stands disposed off.

(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE rashmi Shiva vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10462554/
